name: Mount Rainier – Paradise Corridor
agency: NPS Mount Rainier GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Subalpine wildflower meadows, cascading waterfalls, and high-altitude viewpoints overlooking active glaciers.

trails.name: Skyline Trail Loop via Panorama Point & Myrtle Falls
trails.condition_note: Early/late season snowfields near Panorama Point; trek poles recommended.
trails.description: Mount Rainier's premier subalpine and alpine loop climbing beside the Nisqually Glacier to Panorama Point (6,800 ft) and descending past Myrtle Falls.

trails.name: Nisqually Vista Loop
trails.condition_note: Family-friendly paved loop with direct views of Nisqually Glacier.
trails.description: Accessible subalpine meadow loop offering close-up views of the snout of the Nisqually Glacier and Mount Rainier's upper icefalls.

pois.name: Panorama Point (6,800 ft)
pois.note: Views of Mt. Adams, Mt. St. Helens & Mt. Hood
